mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_devices (user_id, device_token, platform, device_name, app_version, os_version, locale, is_active, last_used_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceToken}, #{platform}, #{deviceName}, #{appVersion}, #{osVersion}, #{locale}, #{isActive}, #{lastUsedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = #{userId}, platform = #{platform}, device_name = #{deviceName}, app_version = #{appVersion}, os_version = #{osVersion}, locale = #{locale}, is_active = TRUE, last_used_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE user_devices SET platform = #{platform}, device_name = #{deviceName}, app_version = #{appVersion}, os_version = #{osVersion}, locale = #{locale}, is_active = #{isActive}, last_used_at = #{lastUsedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_devices WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_used_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_devices WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY last_used_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_devices SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE device_token = #{deviceToken}
UPDATE user_devices SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_devices SET last_used_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE device_token = #{deviceToken}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_devices WHERE is_active = TRUE
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_devices WHERE is_active = TRUE AND last_used_at < #{lastActiveTime}
